disposition_reason: Selenium uptake and speciation in laboratory-cultured microalga; not a food survey.

study.design: laboratory culture experiment exposing Chlorella vulgaris to sodium selenite 0 to 200 mg/L for 144 h
study.method: ICP-MS for total and inorganic selenium in dried algae; organic selenium by difference; enzyme and pigment assays
study.qa: spiked controls compared with cultured groups

non_numeric_findings: Highest total selenium in algae 857 ug/g dry weight; maximum organic selenium 316 ug/g at 75 mg/L selenite after 6 days (Results, p. 4).
Accumulated selenium was more than 68% organic and less than 32% inorganic (Results, p. 4).
Growth promoted at 75 mg/L or less and inhibited above 100 mg/L (Abstract).
